_comment: What sample_bill.pdf SAYS, recorded by reading the document -- not by running the
pipeline and writing down what it produced. This file is the gate's independent
source of truth (app #113): the gate compares the pipeline's extraction against
these values, so an extraction that silently stops reading the document fails.
If you change sample_bill.pdf, open it, read it, and update this file by hand.
Never regenerate it from pipeline output -- that restores the tautology this
